tools.name: junglee--Amazon-crawler
tools.title: Amazon Product Scraper
tools.description:
Amazon Product Scraper. Use this Amazon scraper to collect data based on URL and country from the Amazon website. Extract product information without using the Amazon API, including reviews, prices, descriptions, and Amazon Standard Identification Numbers (ASINs). Download data in various structured formats.

When to use: Use when you need Amazon product details or search/category results (title, price, ASIN, rating, reviews count) from product, search or category URLs.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "junglee/Amazon-crawler" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/junglee/Amazon-crawler

categoryOrProductUrls.title: Enter one or more Amazon category or product URLs
categoryOrProductUrls.description: Use a link to the Amazon category you want to scrape, e.g. video games - https://www.amazon.com/s?bbn=16225016011&rh=n%3A20972781011, https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0B3BVWJ6Y. You can also filter within the category with almost any filter available, i.e. price, manufacturer, rating, etc. By using a different URL you can also choose a different Amazon country, e.g. Germany: https://www.amazon.de/. You don't need to set a proxy country to do that. Example: [{"url":"https://www.amazon.com/s?k=keyboard…

maxItemsPerStartUrl.title: Max results (per start URL)
maxItemsPerStartUrl.description: Enter the maximum number of results you want to scrape per each star URL. This will let the scraper know when to stop. Example: 100

language.title: Language
language.description: Language to use on Amazon. **Disclaimer**: each Amazon domain has a different set of supported languages. If you choose a language that is not supported by the domain, the scraper will use the default language of the domain.

proxyCountry.title: Proxy country
proxyCountry.description: You can set proxy country to **avoid geo-blocking** and **access region-specific content**. Amazon shows you the products that can be shipped to your address based on the proxy you use. *By default*, the scraper **automatically selects** the **proxy country** based on the used Amazon website domain, ensuring low blocking rates and results relevant to the base domain.

maxSearchPagesPerStartUrl.title: Maximum search pages (per start URL)
maxSearchPagesPerStartUrl.description: Enter the maximum number of search pages to scrape for each start URL. E.g. only scrape the first 5 pages. This field can also be used with the `maxItemsPerStartUrl` option, the scraper will stop after either one of these limits is reached. Example: 9999

maxProductVariantsAsSeparateResults.title: Maximum product variants per product (as separate results)
maxProductVariantsAsSeparateResults.description: Enter the maximum number of product variants you want to scrape per each product, outputted as separate results. **Please beware** that **you can already get** most of the **variant details** changes, in the **`variantDetails` field**, which is outputted by default. Note that this **will increase the number of requests** and **extend the scraping time**. Example: 0

maxOffers.title: Maximum scraped offers
maxOffers.description: Enter the maximum number of offers you want to scrape per each product. This will let the scraper know when to stop. Note that this **will increase the number of requests** and **extend the scraping time**.

scrapeSellers.title: Scrape sellers
scrapeSellers.description: Enable this option to extract further information about sellers of the product. Scrapes the featured offer seller (main seller). This option goes hand in hand with the `maxOffers` option bby scraping the seller of each offer. If you set `maxOffers` to 0, only the featured offer seller will be scraped. Note that this **will increase the number of requests** and **extend the scraping time**.

useCaptchaSolver.title: Use Captcha solver (warning: see description)
useCaptchaSolver.description: If enabled the scraper will automatically solve captchas thrown by Amazon. This will decrease the amount of request retries and increase the speed of the scraper. ***IMPORTANT*** - This option works well only for the `'.com'` Amazon domain, but even for that one Amazon doesn't show a few product fields after solving a captcha (specifically: 'attributes', 'manufacturer attributes', and 'bestseller ranks')

scrapeProductVariantPrices.title: Scrape product variant prices
scrapeProductVariantPrices.description: Enable this option to extract prices of different variations of a product. Useful when you need prices for each variant. Note that this **will increase the number of requests** and **extend the scraping time**.

scrapeProductDetails.title: Scrape product details
scrapeProductDetails.description: If enabled, the scraper will extract each found product from the category page in detail (this is the default behavior). If disabled, the scraper will only extract the quick product information from the category page. Useful for faster and more lightweight searches for products.

countryCode.title: Country code
countryCode.description: The country code to use as the delivery location.

zipCode.title: Zip code
zipCode.description: The zip code to use as the delivery location. This is useful for more precise location settings, especially in larger countries.

locationDeliverableRoutes.title: Location deliverable routes
locationDeliverableRoutes.description: The list of routes/page types, for which the deliverable location settings should be applied. - This is useful for speeding up the scraping process by not applying the location settings to all pages, for which you don't need the localized data for. - For example, you can set it to `['SEARCH', 'PRODUCT']` to apply the location settings only to search and product pages. - By default, all pages are included.

tools.name: delicious_zebu--ebay-product-listing-scraper
tools.title: eBay Scraper - Listings, Prices & 8 Markets
tools.description:
eBay Scraper - Listings, Prices & 8 Markets. Scrape eBay search results, filtered listings and category pages across 8 marketplaces. Build a search from built-in filters - keywords, category, price, condition, seller, location - or paste URLs. Returns title, price, currency, condition, seller rating, shipping, sold count and more.

When to use: Use when you need active eBay search results or category listings with price, condition, seller rating, shipping and sold count.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "delicious_zebu/ebay-product-listing-scraper" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Search terms — one per line. Each runs as a separate eBay search using the filters below. You can also enter an item number, or use eBay syntax like an "exact phrase" in quotes. Example: ["High-speed infrared sensor"]

ebaySite.title: eBay site
ebaySite.description: Which eBay country site to run the search on. This changes the marketplace itself — currency, language, and which listings appear (e.g. eBay Germany shows German listings in EUR). Only affects the advanced search above; pasted URLs in Option 2 keep their own site. Note: on non-English sites, a few text fields (item location, shipping, sold, watchers) may occasionally be empty. Options: www.ebay.com = United States (ebay.com); www.ebay.co.uk = United Kingdom (ebay.co.uk); www.ebay.de = Germany (…

keywordMatch.title: Keyword match
keywordMatch.description: How keywords are matched, same as eBay's advanced search. Options: 1 = All words, any order; 2 = Any words, any order; 3 = Exact words, exact order; 4 = Exact words, any order.

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude words from your search
excludeKeywords.description: Skip listings that contain these words.

searchTitleDescription.title: Title and description
searchTitleDescription.description: Also search within item descriptions, not just titles.

category.title: In this category
category.description: Limit the search to one main eBay category. For a sub-category, paste a category page URL under 'Option 2 — Search by URL' instead.

minPrice.title: Min price
minPrice.description: Lowest price to include, in the currency of the marketplace set by 'eBay site' above (e.g. USD on ebay.com, EUR on ebay.de).

maxPrice.title: Max price
maxPrice.description: Highest price to include, in the currency of the marketplace set by 'eBay site' above (e.g. USD on ebay.com, EUR on ebay.de).

buyingFormat.title: Buying format
buyingFormat.description: How the item is sold. Only one format applies at a time, matching eBay (which uses a single buying format). Leave as 'Any' to include all formats. Options:  = Any; LH_BIN = Buy It Now; LH_Auction = Auction; LH_BO = Accepts offers; LH_CAds = Classified ads.

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: Item condition, matching eBay's advanced search. 'New' and 'Used' are broad and work across all categories. Options:  = Any; 1000 = New; 3000 = Used; 10 = Not specified.

freeShipping.title: Free shipping
freeShipping.description: Only show items with free shipping.

locatedIn.title: Located in
locatedIn.description: Only items physically located in this country. Different from 'Proxy country', which sets the IP location used to load eBay's localized pages.

availableTo.title: Available to (ships to)
availableTo.description: Only items that ship to this country. Different from 'Located in', which is where the item physically is.

sellers.title: Sellers
sellers.description: eBay seller usernames (the seller's user ID), comma-separated, e.g. nike_store, best_deals_99. Use 'Sellers mode' below to keep only these sellers or to exclude them.

sellersMode.title: Sellers mode
sellersMode.description: Whether the sellers above are included or excluded. Only takes effect when 'Sellers' is filled in. Options: 1 = Include only these sellers; 2 = Exclude these sellers.

listingUrls.title: Listing Page URLs
listingUrls.description: List of eBay listing page URLs (e.g., https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=dresses or https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_from=R40&_nkw=shoe&_sacat=0&Brand=Nike&rt=nc&Occasion=Wedding&_dcat=93427)

maxPages.title: Max pages per URL
maxPages.description: How many result pages to scrape per URL. Each page has up to 240 items. Leave at 0 to scrape every page, or set a number to stop early (e.g. 5).

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Order of the results, matching eBay's own "Sort" dropdown on the listing page. This setting overrides any sort order already present in your input URL. Options: 12 = Best Match; 1 = Time: ending soonest; 10 = Time: newly listed; 15 = Price + Shipping: lowest first; 16 = Price + Shipping: highest first; 7 = Distance: nearest first.

splitByPrice.title: Get all results (beyond eBay's page limit)
splitByPrice.description: eBay only shows the first 100 pages of a search (up to 24,000 listings), and often far fewer when sorted by Best Match. Turn this on to get everything: the Actor splits your search into smaller price ranges that eBay can show in full, collects them one by one, and removes duplicates. Listings are then sorted newest first. Works for keyword searches and eBay search URLs (not category pages), and only when 'Max pages per URL' is 0. Popular keywords can have hundreds of thousands of listings, so s…

proxyCountry.title: Proxy country
proxyCountry.description: Which country's eBay results to load. eBay shows different prices, shipping, currency, and listings by country, so pick the country whose view you want (e.g. United States to see what a US shopper sees). This is different from the 'Located in' filter, which is where items are physically located. Options: US = United States; GB = United Kingdom; DE = Germany; AU = Australia; CA = Canada; FR = France; IT = Italy; ES = Spain; JP = Japan; NL = Netherlands; HK = Hong Kong; SG = Singapore; BR = Brazi…

tools.name: e-commerce--walmart-fast-product-scraper
tools.title: Walmart Fast Product Scraper

startUrls.title: Start URLs

maxProductsPerStartUrl.title: Max products (per start URL)

tools.name: epctex--google-shopping-scraper
tools.title: Google Shopping Insights
tools.description:
Google Shopping Insights. Unlock valuable insights from Google Shopping with our Data Extractor. Get reviews, descriptions, prices, merchant details, and affiliation links.

When to use: Use when you need Google Shopping results for a query: product, price, merchant and reviews across stores.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "epctex/google-shopping-scraper" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: URLs to start with. It should be list or detail URL Example: ["https://www.google.com/search?q=android&source=lnms&tbm=shop&tbs=vw:l"]

queries.title: Search Queries
queries.description: (Required if you don't use 'Input URL') Here you can provide a list of search queries as a Javascript array. This takes precedence over 'Input URL'. Example: ["iPhone"]

includeComparisonPrices.title: Include Comparison Prices

includeSponsoredResults.title: Include Sponsored Product

countryCode.title: Country
countryCode.description: Country determines the IP address of the proxy used for the query and the Google Shopping domain (e.g. google.es for Spain). This setting only applies to Search queries , but not to URLs .

maxItems.title: Maximum number of listing items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of listing items that you want as output. Default is all Example: 60

maxItemsPerQuery.title: Maximum number of per each query
maxItemsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of listing items that you want as output per each query. Default is all Example: 100

tools.name: piotrv1001--aliexpress-listings-scraper
tools.title: AliExpress Search Scraper | Price Tracker & Best Sellers
tools.description:
AliExpress Search Scraper | Price Tracker & Best Sellers. Search AliExpress by keyword or paste search URLs and get product listings with price, original price, discount, rating and sales volume, in your ship-to country and currency. For AliExpress price tracking, dropshipping product research and competitor analysis.

When to use: Use when you need AliExpress search results with price, discount, rating and sales volume for a ship-to country.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

searchQueries.title: Search terms
searchQueries.description: What to search for on AliExpress, one term per line. The Actor builds the search URL for you — this is the easiest way to start. Example: ["wireless earbuds"]

searchUrls.title: Search URLs
searchUrls.description: Optional. Paste AliExpress search result URLs to scrape them exactly as-is — useful when you have already applied filters on the site. Combined with any search terms above.

maxResults.title: Max products
maxResults.description: Maximum number of products to return per run, across all search terms and URLs. Each AliExpress results page holds 60 products, so higher values fetch additional pages.

shipTo.title: Ship to
shipTo.description: The country you buy for. Prices (including VAT where the country charges it on imports, such as the EU and UK), delivery estimates and the products shown all follow this country, as on AliExpress itself. Pick from the list or type a country code or name, for example DE or Germany. Default: United States.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The currency for every price, for example EUR or GBP. Default: USD.

sort.title: Sort by

minPrice.title: Minimum price
minPrice.description: Only products priced at or above this, in the currency chosen above. Leave empty for no minimum.

maxPrice.title: Maximum price
maxPrice.description: Only products priced at or below this, in the currency chosen above. Leave empty for no maximum.

minOrders.title: Minimum orders
minOrders.description: Only products with at least this many units sold (the totalSoldCount field). For a high minimum, sort by Most orders so the run finds them quickly.

minRating.title: Minimum rating
minRating.description: Only products rated at least this many stars out of 5, for example 4.5. Products with no rating yet are left out.

choiceOnly.title: AliExpress Choice only
choiceOnly.description: Only products in the AliExpress Choice program, which comes with faster delivery and easier returns.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: AliExpress blocks datacenter traffic aggressively. Leaving this on the default lets the Actor start on cheap proxies and fall back to residential only when it is actually blocked.

useApifyProxy.description: Use Apify Proxy for requests. Leave the default unless the Actor's README says otherwise.

tools.name: autofacts--shopify
tools.title: Shopify Scraper - Products, Prices, Stock & Inventory
tools.description:
Shopify Scraper - Products, Prices, Stock & Inventory. A Shopify product scraper for any public Shopify store: every variant's price, SKU and stock status, with barcodes, real inventory counts, videos and subscription plans where available. Crawl a whole catalog, a collection, one product URL or a keyword search. No API key needed.

When to use: Use when you need the product catalog of a public Shopify store: variants, prices, SKUs and stock.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "autofacts/shopify" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/autofacts/shopify

startUrls.title: Shopify site start urls
startUrls.description: Start URLs of Shopify site to start the actor. Site root url, category page urls, product page urls are all supported. Example: [{"url":"https://kith.com/collections/kith-tops"}]

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max result records
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: The maximum number of records saved to the dataset. Each record is one billed result, so this is also the run's cost cap. The scraper stops when the limit is reached. If set to 0 , there is no limit — use the run's Max total charge setting to bound spend instead.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return. Hidden parameter, overrides maxRequestsPerCrawl if set.

maxRecommendationsPerProduct.title: Max recommended products
maxRecommendationsPerProduct.description: The maximum number of recommended products to fetch per product. Recommendations are returned nested inside the product record and are billed per recommended product, so a value of 20 can cost up to 20 extra events per product. Set to 0 to disable. Default is 0, max is 20.

grabRealInventory.title: Grab real inventory (experimental)
grabRealInventory.description: Fetch each product's real per-variant inventory count from its product JSON. Billed as a separate event for every product that comes back with a real stock count. On collection crawls it also adds one request per product. Only works for stores that expose inventory in their storefront JSON — others report inventory as unknown, and are not billed for it. Off by default.

maxInventoryFetches.title: Max inventory detail-fetches per run
maxInventoryFetches.description: Hard cap on the extra per-product detail fetches used to read inventory on collection crawls. Advanced, not shown in the form: unlimited unless set. Pass a number in the JSON input to cap the run. Only applies when 'Grab real inventory' is enabled.

grabStorefrontDetail.title: Grab storefront detail (selling plans & video)
grabStorefrontDetail.description: Fetch each product's storefront payload for selling plans (subscriptions, pre-orders), video media, and the product's price span. Applies to collection crawls only — product URLs always fetch this payload, because it is where their stock availability comes from. Costs one extra request per product on collection crawls, and is not billed as a separate event. Off by default.

maxStorefrontFetches.title: Max storefront fetches per run
maxStorefrontFetches.description: Hard cap on the extra per-product storefront fetches on collection crawls. Advanced, not shown in the form: unlimited unless set. Pass a number in the JSON input to cap the run. Only applies when 'Grab storefront detail' is enabled; product URLs are already bounded by the record limit.

grabContentSections.title: Grab product information panels (tabs & accordions)
grabContentSections.description: Also return the labelled information panels the store shows outside the description - tabs and accordions such as Features, Includes, Materials or Care - as the site renders them, in a `contentSections` field. Labels are kept exactly as shown, so panels like Shipping or Returns come along too and are yours to filter. Costs one extra page request per product on stores that have them; stores that have none are detected and skipped. Billed per product that actually returns panels.

maxContentSectionFetches.title: Max panel fetches per run
maxContentSectionFetches.description: Caps how many product pages the panel extraction may fetch in one run. Advanced, not shown in the form: unlimited unless set. Pass a number in the JSON input to cap the run. Only applies when "Grab product information panels" is on; a product URL is not capped by this.

proxy.title: Proxy configuration
proxy.description: Select proxies to be used by your crawler.

useApifyProxy.description: Use Apify Proxy for requests. Leave the default unless the Actor's README says otherwise.

annotations.title: Shopify Scraper - Products, Prices, Stock & Inventory

tools.name: publicrecords--etsy-search-scraper
tools.title: Etsy Scraper — Listings, Prices & Best Sellers
tools.description:
Etsy Scraper — Listings, Prices & Best Sellers. Scrape Etsy search results by keyword, category or market page: title, price, rating, reviews, Bestseller and Star Seller badges, ad flag and search rank.

When to use: Use when you need what ranks on Etsy for a keyword, category or market page: position, price, rating, review count, Bestseller/Star Seller badges and whether the listing is an ad.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "publicrecords/etsy-search-scraper" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/etsy-search-scraper

queries.title: Search keywords
queries.description: Keywords to search, one per line (e.g. ceramic mug). Each keyword lands on Etsy's /market page, then pages through Etsy's own search API — every listing on the page (rendered and lazy-loaded), in Etsy's rank order. Example: ["ceramic mug"]

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Order of results, as on Etsy's own sort menu. Applies to search keywords (a market phrase with a sort set runs as a keyword search). Options: relevance = Relevance (Etsy default); newest = Newest; price_asc = Price: low to high; price_desc = Price: high to low; top_reviews = Top customer reviews.

maxPrice.title: Max price
maxPrice.description: Highest price to include, whole units. Leave empty for no maximum.

marketPhrases.title: Market phrases
marketPhrases.description: Phrases for Etsy's /market/ pages (any phrase resolves). Example: personalized dog collar

categoryUrls.title: Category URLs
categoryUrls.description: Etsy category pages, e.g. https://www.etsy.com/c/jewelry/necklaces (no query string). Read in Etsy's default order.

maxPages.title: Max pages per input
maxPages.description: Pages per input, 1–20 (Etsy's own cap). On the Standby/MCP endpoint one call stops at 240 s and says so (truncated:true with pagesDone/pagesRequested); big jobs belong in a batch run.

maxItems.title: Max listings per run (0 = no cap)
maxItems.description: Stop after this many listing rows across all inputs. Raise it (or set 0 for no cap) to get more pages.

maxCacheAgeHours.title: Max snapshot age (hours)
maxCacheAgeHours.description: Serve a keyword from our recent snapshot of the same search when it is at most this many hours old and holds every row you asked for; otherwise fetch live. Snapshot rows say data_source "cache", stale true and as_of (when they were read live), and are charged like live rows. 0 = always fetch live.

fillLazyCards.title: Return every listing on the page
fillLazyCards.description: Etsy renders 12 cards and lazy-loads the rest (48 more on page 1). On, the run fetches them the way Etsy's own page does, so you get the whole page in rank order. Off, you get the 12 rendered cards per page only (faster, fewer requests on your proxy).

is_star_seller.title: Star Seller shops only
is_star_seller.description: Only return listings from Star Seller shops.

free_shipping.title: Free shipping only
free_shipping.description: Only return listings with free shipping.

is_discounted.title: On sale only
is_discounted.description: Only return listings currently on sale.

is_handmade_only.title: Handmade only
is_handmade_only.description: Only return listings Etsy flags as handmade.

is_personalizable.title: Personalizable only
is_personalizable.description: Only return listings that offer personalization.

max_processing_days.title: Ready to ship within (days)
max_processing_days.description: Only return listings whose processing time is at most this many days (Etsy's ready-to-ship filter).

ship_to.title: Ships to (country code)
ship_to.description: Two-letter code, e.g. US, GB, DE.

source.title: Source
source.description: Optional free-text label for this run (for example the Make template that started it). Copied onto every listing row and onto RUN_SUMMARY so template runs can be filtered. Leave empty if you do not need it.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Etsy blocks datacenter IPs. Default: Apify Proxy RESIDENTIAL, included in the event prices (no separate proxy or compute charge). Your own residential proxy works too. A blocked page is never charged.

useApifyProxy.description: Use Apify Proxy for requests. Leave the default unless the Actor's README says otherwise.

annotations.title: Etsy Scraper — Listings, Prices & Best Sellers
